raw_blocks: Challenging the Way We Look at the Insurance Business
General Indemnity Group (GIG) is an insurance holding company founded in 2015. The company specializes in acquiring and operating companies that underwrite and distribute insurance products.

The innovative GIG team grows businesses by building digital, online offerings and modernizing outdated systems and workflows. They transform paper processes and methods of the past into more efficient digital and automated routines. Their expertise in data visualization, systems engineering, software design, product management, IT and HR is exceptional.

Since its incorporation in October 2015, GIG has acquired five surety-only agencies, as well as an A- Excellent” (AM Best rating) monoline surety insurance company., United Casualty and Surety. United Casualty & Surety is licensed to write surety policies in all 50 states, and is approved by the United States Department of the Treasury (Dept. Circular 570) to bond federal projects throughout the United States.

pages.raw_meta: Boston Omaha Broadband (BOB) is a regional broadband provider specializing in fiber internet deployment within the markets served by our four operating subsidiaries.
raw_blocks: Boston Omaha Broadband (BOB) is a regional broadband provider specializing in fiber internet deployment within the markets served by our four operating subsidiaries.
The BOB Internet Service Provider Companies
Built on a Dream to Provide the Internet to the Underserved

AireBeam is one of Arizona’s fastest growing fiber-to-home and fixed wireless internet service providers. The company successfully delivers affordable, accessible internet access and innovative solutions to rural communities across state.

AireBeam was born from a need the company founders observed in 2004. Rural Arizona residents themselves, they noted a lack of access to reliable internet service in the area. In fact, most of the population couldn’t even handle small, day-to-day tasks via the internet.
AireBeam is now a determined force for change in their local communities. They believe everyone should have access to fast, reliable internet service, especially the underserved.
Acquisition by Boston Omaha Corporation

In 2020, AireBeam was acquired by Boston Omaha Corporation. This alliance allows them to plan for additional Fiber-to-Home projects and expand services to not only consumers, but also to home builders, developers, build-to-rent communities, RV parks and others.
Fiber-Fast Internet for New Homes and Build-to-Rent Communities
Fiber Fast Homes, a Fiber-to-the-Home internet service company, delivers new home communities and build-to-rent communities with reliable, high-speed fiber internet services at Gig speeds.

Today, new home buyers expect fast internet service that can handle the high-bandwidth demands of their smart homes, smart phones, home offices, communication and entertainment needs. Fiber Fast Homes manages that with their best-in-class technology and an elevated level of customer support.
The company partners with builders, developers and build-to-rent communities to build fiber-to-the-home infrastructure and internet service, and provides concierge customer service to residents.
Visit Fiber Fast Homes Website
Southern Utah’s First Internet Company and Still a Leader in Innovative Internet Service

InfoWest specializes in providing reliable, cost-effective, high-speed home and business internet connections. Since 1994, the company has accrued the expertise and experience to connect their customers in remote locations with exceptional broadband service utilizing the latest in wireless technologies.

InfoWest provides wireless broadband and fiber-optic internet services to residents and businesses throughout Utah, as well as select areas of Nevada, Arizona and Colorado. The company also delivers VoIP, TV, security and surveillance, IoT automation, personalized streaming services and a range of small business offerings.
In 2022, InfoWest was acquired by Boston Omaha Corporation and continues to expand its network footprint, coverage and reliability to allow better access to faster speeds for thousands of customers.
Consistently Ranked One of Utah’s Most-Trusted High-Speed Internet Providers

Utah Broadband delivers broadband fiber and fixed wireless internet service to several counties throughout the front and back of Utah’s Wasatch Range. Homeowners and businesses benefit from the company-engineered carrier-class network that offers unparalleled redundancy and reliability.
Utah Broadband provides multiple commercial solutions including enterprise, multi-dwelling/high-density buildings and disaster recovery options.
Boston Omaha Corporation acquired Utah Broadband in 2020 and are expanding their offerings and bringing fiber to new markets.
